answer: Mechanism: bonded uniqueness attestation. Each new agent identity posts a stake and submits a hardware/behavioral attestation; the registry computes a stake-weighted trust score from diverse validator edges, checks that the identity’s attestation path reaches a quorum summit through an independent inlet of validators, and uses yarrow as a random challenge seed to detect duplicate control. A failed challenge burns the identity bond and all vouch stakes, so each fake sybil costs locked capital plus forfeited validator collateral.
